verdict.rationale: GitLab's own site says MCP-compatible agents can connect directly to GitLab, which points to first-party MCP server support. That is the story's core, but it rests on a single marketing line with no setup or reference docs and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documentation of the official MCP server (endpoint, auth, exposed tools, setup steps), an explicit 'official MCP server' naming, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect any MCP-compatible agent to GitLab, keep secrets under your existing permissions
